uncertainty.panel_bootstrap: Same paired circular-origin method as the original protocol
uncertainty.synchronized_secondary: Within each test year, form the sorted union of available forecast-origin dates across markets, resample circular blocks of40 union dates, use the same date multiplicities for all markets/horizons/methods, retain each cell only at its own observed dates. Equal-weight the22 resulting cell ratios. This checks same-year cross-market dependence without fabricating prices.
uncertainty.interpretation: Both are nominal conditional intervals. No inference about an independent population of markets; neither selects or retrains a model. Synchronized interval is secondary and does not replace the frozen primary decision.

comparison_caveats: Candidate uses daily three-feature histories and joint horizons; GAS comparison uses one mature h-return process per horizon.
Candidate has zero conditional log-return mean and variance proportional to h; GAS/GMM can learn location and separate horizon scale.
